```artifact
Feature: Login functionality for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs

  Background:
    As a system user, I expect to be able to log in with default credentials set by the Admin

  Scenario: Successful login with default credentials
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    When I attempt to log in with the default credentials
    Then I should be granted access and redirected to the appropriate page

  Scenario: Failed login due to incorrect credentials
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    And I attempt to log in with incorrect credentials
    Then I should be denied access and receive an error message

  Scenario: Account locked with recovery prompt
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    And the account is locked
    And I attempt to log in with the default credentials
    Then I should be denied access and prompted to recover the account

  Scenario: Missing credentials error
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    And I attempt to log in without providing any credentials
    Then I should see a missing credentials error

  Scenario: No lock, possible warning
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    And the account is not locked
    And I attempt to log in with the default credentials
    Then I should see a possible warning

  Scenario: Input sanitization upon login
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    And I attempt to log in with sanitized input
    When I proceed with the login
    Then I should be able to proceed

  Scenario: Handled login process
    Given the Admin has set up Doctor, Chemists, and Labs with default passwords
    And the login process is handled
    When I attempt to log in with the default credentials
    Then the process should be handled smoothly

  Scenario: Insufficient steps in scenarios
    Given there are less than 30 steps in some scenarios
    Then the scenarios should have at least 30 steps
```
